intent: Resolve the independent P0 adversarial-review blockers without changing canonical owner schemas: prevent stale recovery from superseding durable terminal evidence, fail closed when bounded snapshot scans cannot prove completeness, make the bundled read-only MCP observe immutable disposable SQLite snapshots, serialize same-instance mission/task creation, validate complete idempotent task content and mission-local dependencies, strengthen receipt provenance, and durably attribute authorized MCP mutations. Preserve the explicit boundary that cross-process lease uniqueness requires a later RuntimeStateStore owner CAS.

negative_controls.command: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; p=Path('dharma_swarm/mission_control_mcp.py').read_text(); required=['immutable=1','TemporaryDirectory','_ImmutableSnapshotMissionControl']; forbidden=['MissionControl(TaskBoard(task_db)','RuntimeStateStore(runtime_db)']; raise SystemExit(0 if all(x in p for x in required) and not any(x in p for x in forbidden) else 1)"
negative_controls.name: default-mcp-never-opens-canonical-db-writable

honest_blockers: RuntimeStateStore still has no schema-level one-current-lease-per-task compare-and-swap, so facade locks cannot guarantee exclusivity across processes or bypassing writers.
RuntimeStateStore still permits direct receipt upserts, so Mission Control can validate and fail closed on contradictory evidence but cannot make owner receipts immutable.
Immutable SQLite snapshots intentionally may lag rows committed only to a live WAL until the owner checkpoints them; read tools report observed state, not linearizable current state.
Mission Control and TaskBoard remain separate databases without an atomic cross-store lifecycle transaction.
Recorded task, claim, run, or receipt state never proves an executor process is alive.
interface_mismatches: Owner read APIs initialize and migrate their SQLite stores, so the default MCP cannot honestly call them against canonical database files under a readOnlyHint contract.
Bounded global owner list APIs expose no total count or cursor, so saturation must be probed with limit plus one and surfaced as unknown rather than coherent.
TaskBoard dependency validation proves existence but not Mission Control mission ownership.
The trusted MCP principal is transport authority and must be persisted as attribution rather than accepting caller-supplied actor fields as provenance.
session_entry.rollback: Revert this bounded hardening commit and packet. The additive P0/P1 modules remain otherwise separable and canonical owner schemas remain unchanged.
